verdict.rationale: FreeAgent ships automation features such as automated invoices and reminders and smart categorisation, so versioning, reviewing and rolling back automations is a fair question for this product. No evidence shows any version history, review, or rollback for those automations. The X-Api-Version header versions the API itself, not user automations, so it does not count.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
